newsitem.title: ITALY: ENI slips as Italy ups second tranche offer.
newsitem.headline: ENI slips as Italy ups second tranche offer.

text.p: Shares in Italy's energy giant ENI slipped over two percent after the Italian Treasury announced late Thursday that it is to increase the size of the second tranche offer of shares due to strong investor demand, dealers said.

The Treasury said it was increasing the number of shares being offered to 1.1 billion shares from 700 million, and said the green-shoe over-allotment option would be up to 15 percent of the new offer rather than 105 million in the original offer.
The public subscription for the second tranche offer in Italy finishes on Friday, and the share price is due to be fixed on October 26 with trading due to start on October 28.
ENI shares slipped to an early low of 7,120 lire before settling at 0910 GMT off 2.08 percent at 7,150 lire.
